**Structuring the Interface**

I'm now focusing on the core structure, designing the UI around a Hogwarts-inspired framework. I'm thinking of "Aetherion," "Ignivar," "Verdantis," and "Lunaris" as houses for a dynamic map interface. I will have a library for lessons, a great hall for quizzes, an arena for games, and the Gemini chatbot for help, along with social features and a leaderboard. The chatbot will be for study help, using Gemini-3-Flash. I am leaning toward Tailwind classes for a colorful, high-contrast, and accessible visual style.
